population_exposure: log(1 + earlier delivered pitches of the same Statcast type to this hitter in this game), regardless of pitcher
population_estimand: Within batter-game-pitch-type association; frozen pitch-context residuals already adjust for pitcher identity and measured pitch properties; the controlled version adds exposure to other pitch types and plate-appearance progress
forecast_primary_contrast: same-type earlier contact and swing history across all pitchers versus the same model with mean earlier same-type context-adjusted swing deviation
other_pitcher_diagnostic: Restrict evaluation to pitches with an earlier tracked swing of this type from another pitcher; compare other-pitcher same-type outcome history with and without other-pitcher mechanical deviation
interpretation: Observational association and a chronological pitch-type-conditioned prediction check. Neither design identifies causal learning or a stable individual talent.
